Wave programme

Primary cases first; controlled extensions follow the agreed checks.

Sequence	Height H [m]	Wavelength λ [m]	Purpose

W01	0.50	20	Primary wave case · 4λ domain
W01 domain check	0.50	20	3λ versus 4λ sensitivity
W02	0.50	30	Primary wavelength comparison · 4λ

Planned work. First verify wave height, phase, reflection, encounter direction and time resolution. Average complete settled cycles, targeting 8–10 encounter periods. A finer free-surface mesh for low H requires a matched baseline. Horizontal domains follow the planned wavelength checks; vertical depth remains 24 m.
